structured_output.summary: The finding no longer applies to the current code, so I changed nothing. src/ui/hud.ts has no `let entering` flag and no early-return guard any more. Its `enter(on)` is just `restartClass(element, 'is-entering', on);` (hud.ts:195-197), which is the same shape as touch-controls' `enter`. The only `entering` state left is in race-ui.ts:93, which guards the single caller, and in touch-controls.ts:99, where it is used by `zones()`, so it isn't a duplicate. The duplicated state and dead guard the reviewer describes were already removed, apparently by the earlier R1-1 restart fix that the verifier mentions. There is no duplication or dead code left to delete, so there is no change and no test.
